title: Retire unused marketing and profile leaves; recover active subscription transport failures

source.ref: Current-main runtime/source-reader inventory and actual Frequency subscription/pricing replacements

detail: Removed unreferenced old marketing subscribe renderer, old pricing interval/audience contexts, and unused profile tab type leaf. Actual subscribe route mounts FrequencySubscribeForm with the existing confirmation/anti-enumeration action; pricing mounts PlanPeriodScope/Switch and actual catalog-fed plans; profile page mounts current Frequency profile body. No server action, email policy, plan, route or profile tab removed. Actual Frequency form now catches rejected server-action transport, reports a generic retry message and leaves loading state. Mocked rendered tests prove recovery, disabled pending state and existing application error behavior; actual pricing switches remain synchronized across both bands. No provider call or production data change.

verify.evidence: 21 focused rendered interaction/catalog tests PASS: active subscription rejection recovery, pending/error behavior and synchronized pricing bands; focused lint and whitespace PASS. Actual route imports and all-tree source-reader census verified before retirement. No live email or full-app acceptance claim.
